abstract: Use the official Anthropic Python and TypeScript SDKs against self-hosted Messages endpoints. Covers base URL without /v1, auth_token versus api_key per server, keys without printing secrets, custom headers, timeouts, retries, proxies, streaming, tool use, thinking, betas, recipes for vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LiteLLM and llama-swap with model-name mapping, and troubleshooting, with a Node smoke test and a read-only endpoint probe script.
